title: Florida channel wakes up with an unexplained metal filling

tellings.quote: behold, he wakes up when he realizes he has a metal filling that he never had.

plain: In the early 1970s a man in Florida who served as a channel, someone said to pass on messages from other beings, woke up to find a metal filling in his tooth that he never had before. A researcher named Greg Malatzi tells this from a book called The Stargate Conspiracy, in an account involving the medium Phyllis Schlemmer and the researcher Andrija Puharich. It is told as a sign that something had been done to the man in his sleep.
